name: Test environment WL428T73
description: Test environment WL428T73 was a designation given by Iokath creators to a planet located in the Unknown Regions of the galaxy. Z17AX558 was chosen by the species as a test environment for their weapons of mass destruction and a new fully-integrated, and optimized planetary assault platform completely eradicated the local sentient population. The invaders discovered an underground vault filled with artifacts, but were unable to determine their exact value.
